CIA escalates secret war on cartels with deadly operations inside Mexico

status_summary: No public record of the Mandate's 60-day review of existing covert action findings by the NSC Senior Director for Intelligence Programs, of an assessment of which agencies are best equipped, or of DOD capabilities being placed under covert action findings was found. Press reports describe new covert action instead: on 2025-10-15 the President publicly confirmed authorizing CIA covert action in Venezuela, which anonymous US officials told the New York Times was set out in a classified presidential finding, and a CNN report republished 2026-05-12, relying mostly on anonymous sources, described an expanded CIA campaign against cartels in Mexico after the President formally updated and expanded the agency's authorities. The Mandate contemplates new findings as a possible outcome of its review, so these reports are related context rather than evidence that the review took place. Because covert action is classified, this assessment rests on press reporting.

timeline.event: Reporting by the New York Times, carried by the Boston Globe, said the administration had secretly authorized the CIA to conduct covert action in Venezuela under a classified presidential finding, citing anonymous officials; the President publicly confirmed that he had authorized it.

CNN reported, mostly from anonymous sources, an expanded CIA campaign against cartels in Mexico following a formal update and expansion of the agency's authorities; the CIA declined to comment and Mexico's president said she was not told in advance of one operation.

title: Review all covert action findings in 60 days and use DOD capabilities in support
uncertainties: No public record was found of the 60-day NSC review of covert action findings, an assessment of which agencies are best equipped, or DOD capabilities placed under findings. Press reports describe new covert action in Venezuela and Mexico, mostly on anonymous sources apart from a public presidential confirmation about Venezuela; these are related context. Federal Register searches returned nothing, as expected for classified findings; H.R. 7632 is unrelated; the CIA stories page showed nothing, and dni.gov and defense hosts were blocked; one news search returned historical material. The NSC, CIA and ODNI have no list in the reginfo.gov Unified Agenda (2026 Regulatory Plan and Unified Agenda edition), and the Department of War list holds nothing related. A classified review could have occurred without notice. Checked systematically on 2026-10-19.
